## Summary

The repository had no continuous integration. This adds a GitHub Actions workflow that runs on every pull request and on pushes to `main`:

- PHP 8.3 (the production version on Forge) and 8.4, SQLite in memory, Composer and npm caches.
- `npm run build`, so the Tailwind build is verified and the Blade views find a Vite manifest.
- `vendor/bin/pint --test` for code style.
- `php artisan test`.

To start green, the branch also applies Pint to the nine files it flagged (whitespace, import order, `new Foo()` parentheses; no behaviour change) and gives the stock Laravel example test an in-memory database, so the home page it requests has a `vehicles` table. Locally: 23 tests, 161 assertions, Pint passes.

## After merge

Nothing on the server. Optionally require the `PHP 8.3` check in the branch protection for `main`.
